newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen up on new accounts day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen up on new accounts day.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are likely to gain on Wednesday mainly on fresh buying of blue chips on new accounts day, dealers said.

"We don't expect a sharp surge in the index like that of Tuesday, but blue chips like PTCL and Hub Power will gain further," dealer Rony Byramjee said. "There was a lot of short selling in the last few days and a rebound is due."
Dealers said fresh buying would also spill over to lift second-tier stocks in demand from local and foreign investors.
On Tuesday, the index rose 76.57 points, or 4.06 percent, to 1,964.21. Losers led gainers 175 to 53.
Turnover rose to 96.41 million shares from 81.92 million in the previous session.
